submissionChannel.note: Licensees apply through IFZA-registered partners on the Partner Portal; no direct licensee login confirmed.

leaseAtRenewal.text: No official rule found on lease validity at renewal.

renewalWindow.text: The licence must be renewed on or before the expiry date. No official advance window found.

renewsTogether.item: Financial statements are submitted with the renewal; a three-month preparation period after financial year-end is allowed.

ifLate.text: An expired licence cannot be used to trade, banks may suspend accounts, and fines may be imposed. If not renewed, the licence may be struck off and visas may be cancelled or marked absconding. Amendments cannot be made on an expired licence. A grace period exists but its length is not stated.
ifLate.source: IFZA renewal guide; IFZA missed-renewal article
